# netbox_sites (Data Source)

Lists site objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_sites" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-site" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: facility, facility__empty, facility__ic, facility__ie, facility__iew, facility__iregex, facility__isw, facility__n, facility__nic, facility__nie, facility__niew, facility__nisw, facility__regex, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner_id, owner_id__n, slug, slug__empty, slug__ic, slug__ie, slug__iew, slug__iregex, slug__isw, slug__n, slug__nic, slug__nie, slug__niew, slug__nisw, slug__regex, status, status__empty, status__ic, status__ie, status__iew, status__iregex, status__isw, status__n, status__nic, status__nie, status__niew, status__nisw, status__regex, tag, tag__any, tag__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `sites` (Attributes List) The matching sites. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sites))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--sites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sites`

Read-Only:

- `asn_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of ASNs assigned to the site.
- `circuit_count` (Number) Number of circuits at the site.
- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `device_count` (Number) Number of devices at the site.
- `facility` (String) Local facility ID or description.
- `group_id` (Number) Id of the site group.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id of the site.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `latitude` (Number) GPS coordinate in decimal format (xx.yyyyyy).
- `longitude` (Number) GPS coordinate in decimal format (xx.yyyyyy).
- `name` (String) Full name of the site.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `physical_address` (String)
- `prefix_count` (Number) Number of prefixes at the site.
- `rack_count` (Number) Number of racks at the site.
- `region_id` (Number) Id of the region.
- `shipping_address` (String)
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly unique shorthand; derived from name when not set.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: planned, staging, active, decommissioning, retired.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.
- `timezone` (String) Time zone name, e.g. Europe/Berlin.
- `url` (String)
- `virtual_machine_count` (Number) Number of virtual machines at the site.
- `vlan_count` (Number) Number of VLANs at the site.
